basic_information.recipe_name: Standard Exhaust Dyeing of Cotton Knits with Bifunctional Reactive Dyes

dye_information.dye_name: Reactive Blue 19 (1.2% owf) + Reactive Red 195 (0.5% owf) + Reactive Yellow 145 (0.3% owf)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Electrolyte to drive dye exhaustion onto fiber surface
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added in 2 equal splits at 40°C prior to alkali dosing
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with non-ionic and anionic wetting agents
chemical_information.incompatible_chemicals: Cationic fixing agents, strong concentrated acids

chemical_information.chemical_function: Alkali buffer to generate cellulosate ions for covalent dye fixation
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed exponentially over 30 min after 20 min salt exhaustion hold
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with standard reactive dye auxiliaries

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Start 40°C -> Heat to 60°C @ 1.5°C/min -> Hold 60 min -> Cool to 50°C @ 2.0°C/min -> Soap @ 95°C
process_parameters.ph: Exhaustion pH: 6.8 - 7.2 | Fixation pH: 10.8 - 11.2 | Neutralized pH: 6.0 - 6.5

process_steps.pretreatment: Scoured & bleached cotton; core pH 6.5; residual H2O2 < 5 ppm
process_steps.dye_addition: Dissolve dyes in warm water (50°C), strain through mesh, dose over 10 min at 40°C
process_steps.salt_addition: Dose Glauber's salt (45 g/L) in two portions (50% at 40°C, 50% at 60°C)
process_steps.alkali_addition: Dose Soda Ash (15 g/L) exponentially over 30 min once 60°C is reached
process_steps.washing: Drain fixation bath -> Cold rinse (10 min) -> Hot rinse at 70°C (10 min)
process_steps.soaping: Neutralize with Acetic Acid (1.0 g/L) -> Soap with Polymeric Agent at 95°C for 15 min
process_steps.neutralization: Final rinse with Acetic Acid (0.5 g/L) to bring core fabric pH to 6.0 - 6.5
process_steps.drying: Relaxation dryer or Stenter frame at 120°C to target 6% moisture
process_steps.finishing: Apply 1.5% Bio-softener via padding or exhaust at 40°C

machine_requirement.recommended_machine: Fong's / Thies Soft-Flow Jet Dyeing Vessel

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 3-4

defects.common_defects: Patchiness / Unlevelness, Crease Marks, Low Wet Fastness
defects.causes: Rapid alkali addition, turn time > 120 s, incomplete removal of hydrolyzed dye
defects.corrective_actions: Leveling agent strip & redye; optimize exponential alkali dosing; ensure soaping at 95°C

safety.ppe_required: Chemical splash goggles, neoprene gloves, rubber apron, dust mask during dye powder weighing
safety.safety_precautions: Operate eye wash station nearby; store acids and alkalis in separate bunded areas

references.source: SDC / AATCC Standard Reactive Dyeing Guidelines
references.notes: Ensure total dissolved solids (TDS) of input water < 250 ppm and hardness < 10 ppm
